title: The Final Boss
description: A chaos‑themed mod adding devastating bosses, powerful items, and world‑ending attacks for extreme survival.
body:
English:
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


This is the 1.20.1 version of one of my mods with the same name, but aside from both having the core entity 'The Final Boss,' they have almost no connection.
This mod only adds some not very powerful creatures and a few items.
If you are interested in this mod, feel free to download and play it anytime. This is the 1.20.1 version of one of my mods with the same name, but aside from both having the core entity 'The Final Boss,' they have almost no connection.
This mod only adds some not very powerful creatures and a few items.
If you are interested in this mod, feel free to download and play it anytime.

## What is this mod?
“Final Boss” is a chaos-themed Minecraft mod. It adds a unique, god-like entity that cannot be deleted, can unleash world-destroying attacks, and can permanently remove other entities. It also adds some very interesting and powerful items and entities, some of which are extremely useful in Survival mode!
## Key Features
- ⚔️ The Final Boss: Dynamic, colorful name; immune to standard deletion.
- 🗑️ True Entity Removal: The kill effect is replaced by permanent removal.
- 🔨 Useful Items: You can easily craft and use various items!
- 🔥 Supports 1.20.1: Forge.
## Why is it called “Ultimate Boss”?
Because once it appears, the entire world will be destroyed.
## Notes
- This mod is **deliberately designed to be unbalanced**.
- Recommended for single-player mode.
- Not recommended for casual survival mode.
---

</details>




中文：

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

这是我的一个同名模组的1.20.1版本，不过它们除了都有核心实体“The Final Boss”之外，几乎没有什么关联。
这个模组只添加了一些不是很强力的生物和一些物品。
如果你对该模组感兴趣，欢迎随时下载游玩。这是我的一个同名模组的1.20.1版本，不过它们除了都有核心实体“The Final Boss”之外，几乎没有什么关联。
这个模组只添加了一些不是很强力的生物和一些物品。
如果你对该模组感兴趣，欢迎随时下载游玩。

## 这是个什么模组？
《最终BOSS》是一款以混沌为主题的《我的世界》模组，专为无政府服务器和极限生存模式打造。
它添加了一个独一无二、神一般的实体，该实体无法被删除，能释放毁灭世界的攻击，并能永久移除实体。它还添加了一些非常有趣且强力的物品和实体，其中一部分在生存模式下非常有用！
## 主要特色~~~~
- ⚔️ 最终BOSS：动态彩色名称，免疫常规删除。 
- 🗑️ 真正实体移除：击杀效果被永久移除所取代。
- 🔨有用的物品：你可以轻易合成并使用一些道具！
- 🔥 支持 1.20.1 ： Forge。
## 为何命名为“最终BOSS”？
因为一旦它出现，整个世界都会毁灭。
## 注意事项
- 本模组**刻意设计为不平衡**。
- 建议在单人模式下体验。
- 不推荐用于休闲生存模式。
---

</details>
